plan.development: First four previously consumed paired-local-area recordings. Determine motion admission on these only.
plan.held: Four remaining paired-local-area recordings and seven nonoverlapping public scene-return recordings. Previously exposed sources, unseen trim deliveries. One planned pairing per role per source.
plan.render: 720 by 480 H.264 at 24 fps. Source is 52 pictures. Shorten leading and trailing margins by 3 to 6 pictures each. Encode submitted picture separately. Three edits remain between the flanks.
plan.alignment: Mean signed two- and four-picture motion on each flank. The same offset must have adequate support on both flanks and a lead over every other offset. Points were chosen using only the first four sources. Reuse frozen robust photometric localization without tuning.
plan.gate: Recover at least seven large, seven small and five texture edits by time IoU >= 0.50 and pixel IoU >= 0.10. Correct offset on every admitted related case. No unrelated or shifted-camera admission with a local flag and no unrelated clip admitted. At most two flags on 22 matched ordinary re-encode and grade controls. At least eight re-encode controls must be assessed.
